digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center's per-user token bucket rate limiting (8.6+, DC only, off by default) returns 429 responses that are not retried by the current transport, causing hard failures on rate-limited requests
The Retry-After header must be honoured with up to 20% jitter and clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S, differing from ADR-0036's connectivity backoff curve which applies no jitter to Retry-After
Rate-limit retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only (via opt-in defaulting to OFF) to prevent reintroducing duplicate-issue failures from retrying mutations after partial server writes

The rate_limit_retry flag must reach the retry layer through both _call_logged (PATH A, for _paged_search callers) and direct _with_connection_retry calls (PATH B, for per-issue comment fetches), as the per-issue read is the highest-volume operation most likely to trip the token bucket
Cap exhaustion must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429 via _as_backend_http_error, never leaking JIRAError past the adapter boundary

All four opted-in read sites (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map's _paged_search call, get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, get_parent_map) must pass rate_limit_retry=True, while all ten mutation sites must fail immediately on first 429
